content:
LAREDO — A 21-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Saturday morning on an alleged felony drug charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Roberto Pacheco Jr. was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 7:58 a.m. The booking record lists possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2, under 1 gram — a state jail felony — and possession of marijuana, under 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was not set on either charge.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Roberto Pacheco Jr. arrested on felony drug charge
